items.q: He was in my band nearly four years.

ctx.x: He was in my band nearly four years.
Are you still friendly with him?

items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: No, this comes later. I did join Ernie because he played the Apollo Theater.

ctx.x: So you went to New York but actually you stopped off -- did you stop off with Ernie Fields, I mean you were with him for a short while, then you went to New York, or this was a little later?
No, this comes later. I did join Ernie because he played the Apollo Theater. When my job ran out in Newark, I moved back into Harlem.
Do you remember where you lived in Harlem?
